crossRefs.note: “Shall he who argues contend with the Almighty? He who argues with God, let him answer it.”
Who has directed Yahweh’s Spirit, or has taught him as his counselor?
Who did he take counsel with, and who instructed him, and taught him in the path of justice, and taught him knowledge…
Woe to him who strives with his Maker— a clay pot among the clay pots of the earth! Shall the clay ask him who fashions…
“For who has known the mind of the Lord? Or who has been his counselor?”
“For who has known the mind of the Lord, that he should instruct him?” But we have Christ’s mind.
Should even one who hates justice govern? Will you condemn him who is righteous and mighty?—
Who is like Yahweh, our God, who has his seat on high,
Who stoops down to see in heaven and in the earth?
If you see the oppression of the poor, and the violent taking away of justice and righteousness in a district, don’t…
It is he who sits above the circle of the earth, and its inhabitants are like grasshoppers; who stretches out the…
who brings princes to nothing, who makes the judges of the earth meaningless.
Don’t you know that we will judge angels? How much more, things that pertain to this life?
For if God didn’t spare angels when they sinned, but cast them down to Tartarus, and committed them to pits of darkness…
Angels who didn’t keep their first domain, but deserted their own dwelling place, he has kept in everlasting bonds…
I saw an angel coming down out of heaven, having the key of the abyss and a great chain in his hand.
I saw the dead, the great and the small, standing before the throne, and they opened books. Another book was opened…

translations.web: “Shall any teach God knowledge, since he judges those who are high?
translations.bsb: Can anyone teach knowledge to God, since He judges those on high?
translations.kjv: Shall any teach God knowledge? seeing he judgeth those that are high.
translations.asv: Shall any teach God knowledge, Seeing he judgeth those that are high?
